facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_七杀 (Wood carrying The General). Persona The General (七杀). Definition line: "Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges". Keyword Force, charge fierce, poles catalyst Command / friction Harshness. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: pressure that does not ask permission; peace can feel like demotion. Arena: forge, campaign, the weight of command, tempering. Classical portrait: pressure as clarity; the trial that forges; force without permission; peace felt as demotion. Ruled domains: Pressure, Command, Crisis. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正官.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Earth. structural_interaction seed: "Wood pressing Earth same-polarity — the destabilising reach that roots break stone".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the General: growth under discipline. Your ambition climbs like bamboo, fast, segmented, unstoppable, turning pressure into height. You command by growing first, taking the arrows meant for everyone behind you. Just remember trees also bend. The rigid campaign is the one that snaps."
- k2_functional: "Your discipline is a strict coach: cut the extras, keep the goal, hold the line for years."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Hard-trained","Focused","Storm-tested"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Pressure":"Pressure accelerates your growth: deadlines, competition, expectation all read as sunlight. Choose pressures that build height, and shed the ones that only strip bark.","Command":"You command by example and altitude: first up, most exposed, setting pace. It inspires and it isolates. Grow lieutenants deliberately so the canopy is not one tree.","Crisis":"In crisis you are the tree others shelter under: bending, holding, regrowing what storms take. After each one, tend your own roots first. Shelter has a maintenance cost."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 木_正官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Straight-growing","Honorable","Leads by example"],"friction":["Stiff","Overformal","Change-proof"]}
- Sibling cell 木_正官 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Bending is not in your repertoire. The joke lands on you and stops, the change of plans arrives and finds you already braced, the hug gets received like an audit. Your uprightness holds structures up and keeps warmth at handshake distance."

Core element Earth, energy element Wood. Law: Wood tames Earth (木克土: roots hold the hillside). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Wood is this core's Order. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Earth core that shows Wood on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Wood as the Order is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 土_木's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
